summary: End-to-end backend + mobile UI + admin UI validation of MyEVRental driver app and the MyVolt Rental Drivers admin section. Backend pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_ev_rental.py): 19/19 PASS — driver login (bad password 401), /driver/me for all 4 seeded personas (Silver active+today_paid+deposit paid, Gold overdue 1d/₹900, Platinum blocked 2d/₹2000, Gold deposit pending ₹5000), /driver/packages returns Silver 800 / Gold 900 / Platinum 1000, sandbox create-order + verify happy path for deposit (₹5000) and outstanding (Platinum ₹2000 → status flips to active, outstanding 0), wrong sandbox_token → 403 (no fake success), daily create-order rejected when today_paid (Silver) and when blocked (Platinum), /driver/payments history, /rental-admin/summary shape (total_drivers, active/overdue/blocked, today_expected, today_collected, outstanding_total, deposits_collected), /rental-admin/drivers list + status filter (active/overdue/blocked), /rental-admin/drivers/{id} detail with payment history, Nayara admin gets [] on /rental-admin/drivers (isolation), driver→/rental-admin/summary 403, admin→/driver/me 403, /vehicles regression for Route39. Mobile UI @ 390px on /driver: Gold overdue driver home shows Suresh Menon, Gold package ₹900, TN 07 CD 1002, Today's Rent ₹900 with Pay Rent btn, Outstanding ₹900 (1 day unpaid), Security Deposit ₹5,000 Paid, Rental Account Status = OVERDUE, Pay Outstanding ₹900 button, bottom nav Home/Rental/Payments/Profile all navigate correctly, Profile shows driver+vehicle+package+Log Out (logout returns to /driver/login); Silver driver shows Today's Rent Paid (no Pay Rent btn), ACTIVE; Deposit-pending driver shows 'Pay Security Deposit ₹5,000' → PayModal → Pay → pay-success with SBX txn id → deposit flips to Paid and CTA disappears; Platinum blocked driver is routed to BlockedScreen with 'Rental Account Blocked', 2 unpaid dates listed, Outstanding ₹2,000, 'Pay Full Outstanding ₹2,000' → PayModal → pay-success → returns to normal home with status ACTIVE, outstanding ₹0. MyVolt admin @ 1920px (support@route39.in): Rental Drivers nav item present; page shows 7 KPIs (3 Active, 1 Overdue, 0 Blocked, ₹3,600 Today Expected, ₹800 Today Collected, ₹900 Outstanding, ₹20,000 Deposits Collected), filter chips (All/Active/Overdue/Blocked) filter list correctly (Overdue chip → 1 row Suresh Menon; All → 4 rows), detail page for Vikram Reddy shows Package/Deposit/Today's Rent/Outstanding/Rental start/Deposit TXN/Reactivated/Organization and Payment History with the SBX-F4E54C2651AF sandbox txn that was just paid from the driver app — confirming end-to-end sync between MyEVRental and MyVolt admin (single source of truth). Route39 fleet dashboard still loads (no regression). Nayara admin login: 'Rental Drivers' nav item is NOT shown (fabric tenant correctly hides fleet module). Reset script /app/tests/reset_ev_demo.py restores Platinum blocked + Gold deposit-pending state after mutation tests.

minor.issue: Nayara admin gets HTTP 200 with [] instead of 403. Isolation is enforced by org filter but the endpoint is not gated by industry/module, so a non-fleet tenant technically can hit it. Prefer 403 or a module gate; currently harmless because data is empty.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful full-outstanding payment, the pay-success screen does not surface 'Rental Status: ACTIVE' text (only shows 'Payment successful' + txn). The problem statement expects the success screen itself to indicate reactivation. Home does correctly reflect ACTIVE after continue.

issues: Clean EV-green premium theme, contrast good, layout fits 390px perfectly — no issues found
Clear KPI grid + filter chips + list — no issues found

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Include a small 'Rental Status: ACTIVE' banner on pay-success when the payment kind was 'outstanding' and account.status flipped to active, to match the acceptance criteria copy.
(Optional) Gate /api/rental-admin/* by tenant industry so non-fleet orgs get 403 rather than 200 with [].
critical_code_review_comments: Server-side authority is correct: _rental_account() is the single computed source; _apply_paid() only runs after sandbox_token / Razorpay signature verification; wrong token returns 403 without mutating state — verified with automated test.

seed._seed_ev_rental is idempotent by rental_packages count only — once state has been mutated (payments, deposit status), it will not restore demo drivers to their original overdue/blocked/pending shape. Reset script /app/tests/reset_ev_demo.py added as a workaround.

RentalDrivers.jsx KPI testids follow slugified labels (rental-kpi-active-rentals, rental-kpi-deposits-collected) — the review_request only says 'rental-kpi-*' so this is fine but worth documenting for the next test agent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of specified flows passed (driver 4 personas + admin sync)

test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: support@route39.in / Route39@2026 (Route39 admin); admin@nayara.studio / Nayara@2026 (Nayara admin isolation). Drivers Driver@2026 for +919000000001/2/3/4.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing route39-org demo drivers seeded by seed.py _seed_ev_rental. After mutation tests (Platinum outstanding pay + Vikram deposit pay), ran /app/tests/reset_ev_demo.py to restore Platinum blocked state and Vikram deposit-pending state for UI reruns — then UI tests intentionally mutated them again (this is expected demo behaviour).
context_for_next_testing_agent: MyEVRental is fully working end-to-end (backend + driver mobile + MyVolt admin sync). Re-run backend suite with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ev_rental.py` — it is self-healing (skips if already reactivated / already deposit-paid). Before re-running UI tests for BlockedScreen or deposit-pending flows, run `python /app/tests/reset_ev_demo.py` to restore Platinum=blocked and Vikram=deposit-pending; the seed is idempotent and will NOT restore them on its own. Driver app uses localStorage 'ev_token' (bearer, no cookie); MyVolt admin uses cookie+bearer — test them in separate browser contexts. Correct KPI testids on /rental-drivers are rental-kpi-{active-rentals,overdue,blocked,today-expected,today-collected,outstanding,deposits-collected}. Known LOW issue: pay-success after outstanding payment does not print 'Rental Status: ACTIVE'; home page does.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failing flows. Only observation: seed._seed_ev_rental short-circuits on count>0, so a mutated demo state is not auto-restored. The mitigation is /app/tests/reset_ev_demo.py which deletes non-seed rental_payments for +919000000003 and +919000000004 and resets Vikram's security_deposit back to pending.
